topics.topic: Ownership of mapped-operation aggregate output creation, classification, and persistence, including empty outputs
questions: For a mapped operation node, which module owns creation and disclosure-class assignment of the aggregate output list, including the empty-list case where no service invocation occurs?
Who owns creation, class assignment and persistence requests for a mapped operation node’s aggregate value outputs, including its empty output lists?

quotes: advance_run: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] A value port's PortRef names exactly one StoredValue; a mapped node's value output, once every element succeeded, is one StoredValue holding the canonical JSON array of the elements' values in element order, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's value_schema as items, of the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input, published with put_value_bytes and written by runs when the list is first delivered, never in an element's own change; when its canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant nothing is written and the node is failed for its dependants, which conclude upstream_failed, every element record staying as it is; only a list that is delivered, to a node or a flow output, is measured, and an output no edge takes fails nothing; a mapped node's file output is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, derived from the elements' NodeExecutions whenever it is delivered, after a restart too, since no record of its own holds it, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input; a mapped element receives the list element at its map_index as its own StoredValue of the map_over port's value_schema and the list's class, or the spooled file at that position.

advance_run: [BEHAVIOR] A mapped node over an empty list executes and sends nothing and writes one NodeExecution succeeded without map_index, executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, every output an empty list; a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded, succeeded only when all succeeded.
judgement.why: State 8 assigns aggregate mapped outputs to runs, including publication, persistence, disclosure classification, and the empty-list case, regardless of whether the mapped node is a function or operation.

topics.topic: Ownership and runtime visibility of pinned dependency versions
questions: What module or named build artifact owns the authoritative dependency list and exact versions, and what may the runtime modules know about it?

topics.topic: Ownership and timing of startup cleanup for unreferenced value bytes
questions: Which State 3 module and startup step remove content-addressed value bytes that no record names?

topics.topic: Ownership of canonical raw-file content digest computation
questions: Which module owns computing the canonical digest of raw file bytes used by SpooledFile, trial file-output facts and file fixtures, and which modules merely verify or consume it?

topics.topic: Ownership of credential-safe diagnostic logging and the diagnostic emission capability
questions: Which module owns the invariant that credentials, tokens, host paths and stack traces cannot enter process logs or other diagnostics, and through what capability may modules emit diagnostics?

topics.topic: Ownership of random record identity minting and collision handling
questions: Which module owns the randomness, collision checking and atomic minting of these identities, and which modules may depend on that capability?

topics.topic: Ownership of stateful no-op semantics for equal submissions
questions: Which module owns the stateful no-op semantics when an equal contract version, implementation, trial case, flow version or stored value is submitted?

topics.topic: Semantic writing ownership for SpooledFile records
questions: Which module is the semantic writer of each SpooledFile record: `store`, the producing module (`runs` or `effects`), or another single owner?
